integrity_statement: The claims are supported by an all-size combinatorial proof and by finite direct enumeration for \(1\le n\le9\). Finite enumeration does not certify the all-size theorem.
limitations: No full equivalent for the involution count or fine rank fluctuation law is claimed; published-general-cycle-index priority cannot be excluded.
title: Involutive path partial automorphisms: exact rank series and a half-domain law
